verdict.rationale: The SDK documents built-in tracing that collects LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, and guardrail events (openai-agents-docs-9/18/27), which is a form of telemetry, but no evidence pack item describes any setting, flag, or environment variable to opt out of this tracing or usage tracking. Missing for 10: any documented opt-out flag, privacy/telemetry settings, or explicit statement of user control over data collection.
